final: WITH matched AS (SELECT t.tradekind FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS x ON a.translink = x.transreg JOIN trader AS t ON x.trdref = t.tradereg), counts AS (SELECT tradekind, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM matched GROUP BY tradekind), shares AS (SELECT tradekind, record_count, 1.0 * record_count / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share FROM counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT s.tradekind, s.record_count, s.share, s.share - a.average_share AS share_minus_average FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN avg_share AS a WHERE s.share > a.average_share
